PDF dependencies: pdf-lib 1.17.1 (MIT), @pdf-lib/fontkit 1.1.1 (MIT).
PDF-only static fonts derive from the project NotoSerifCJKKR and PretendardVariable. Static TTF files are zlib-compressed for transport and embedded whole to avoid a CJK subset bug. Gothic derivatives are named PairPDFGothic. Canvas fonts are unchanged.
